exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Can you find food from many different countries where you live? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: How often do you eat typical food from other countries? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Have you ever tried making food from another country? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 5
exercises.prompt: What food from your country would you recommend to people from other countries? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a law that was introduced in your country and that you thought was a very good idea. You should say: what the law was who introduced it when and why it was introduced and explain why you thought this law was such a good idea.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: What kinds of rules are common in a school?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: How important is it to have rules in a school?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: What do you recommend should happen if children break school rules?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Can you suggest why many students decide to study law at university?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 7
exercises.prompt: What are the key personal qualities needed to be a successful lawyer?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 8
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that working in the legal profession is very stressful?
